newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt asks Sudan to explain Khartoum raid.
newsitem.headline: Egypt asks Sudan to explain Khartoum raid.

text.p: An Egyptian foreign ministry official on Tuesday asked Sudan's ambassador to Cairo to explain why police in Khartoum raided an Egyptian company's rest house there, foreign ministry sources said.
Egyptian media said Sudanese police burst into an employees' rest house belonging to an Egyptian public sector company in Khartoum on Monday.
Ambassador Fouad Youssef, who heads the Egyptian Foreign Ministry's Sudan department, called Khartoum's ambassador Ahmed al-Tayeb al-Kordofan to his office to discuss the issue, the sources said.
Kordofan said he would present a report on the incident once he received the relevant information from Khartoum.

Relations between Cairo and Khartoum have been tense for years. They worsened after Egypt accused Sudan's Islamist government of helping gunmen who tried to kill President Hosni Mubarak in the Ethiopian capital Addis Ababa in 1995. Sudan has denied the charge.
